Validate the commercial contract surface of every English product page.

deterministic_generator_chain_ci_step.ci_expectation: git diff --exit-code must show zero difference after re-running all 11 generators against the committed source.
deterministic_generator_chain_ci_step.result: INCONCLUSIVE / COULD NOT BE SAFELY COMPLETED
deterministic_generator_chain_ci_step.reason: The first script (build_locale_ui.py) depends on scripts/translate_fallback_pages.py's translate_values(), which calls the unofficial https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single endpoint for any source string not already present in data/localized-copy-cache.json, with up to 12 retry attempts and up to ~45s sleep between attempts (worst case ~18 minutes per uncached string). A direct read of the cache found 92 header/footer string-locale combinations currently uncached. An actual run hung past 4 minutes with zero output before being stopped to avoid an unbounded delay and to keep this audit read-only-safe. No repository files were modified by the attempt (verified via git status immediately after stopping).
deterministic_generator_chain_ci_step.independent_evidence_of_non_determinism: Comparing the current header.html/footer.html source text against the already-shipped, committed locale-ui.js dictionary (without running the generator) shows real drift: every one of the 10 locale dictionaries contains 6-7 keys for source text that no longer exists verbatim in the current source (stale/orphaned translations), and is missing translations for 11-18 current source strings per locale. This proves locale-ui.js is presently out of sync with header.html/footer.html, which strongly implies the CI 'git diff --exit-code' check would fail if it completed.

critical_content_finding.title: Stale generated locale-ui.js contains a dead key from a corrected factual claim
critical_content_finding.detail: footer.html currently reads '...transparency since 2016.' The committed locale-ui.js dictionary for all 10 locales still keys off the old text '...transparency since 1980.' (translated in all 10 languages). Because the dictionary key no longer matches current source text verbatim, the client-side matcher (locale-ui.js's translateText(), which does an exact dictionary[key] lookup) silently fails to match and does not display the false '1980' date -- but it also means this sentence renders in raw, untranslated English on every non-English page footer, on every page of the site, in all 10 languages.
critical_content_finding.root_cause: The generator (scripts/build_locale_ui.py) was not re-run after the source date correction (1980 -> 2016) was made to header.html/footer.html, so the shipped locale-ui.js was never regenerated to match.
critical_content_finding.scope: All 10 locales; footer is present on effectively every page of the site.
critical_content_finding.verified_by: Direct text comparison of committed locale-ui.js dictionary keys against current header.html/footer.html source strings; no network calls or file writes were used to establish this.
critical_content_finding.not_fixed: Per the change-control rule for this phase, this was documented only and not corrected.

secrets_and_config_safety.note: No real .dev.vars currently exists, so there is no active exposure. However .gitignore only excludes .wrangler/ and the .cloudflare-dist* build directories -- it does not explicitly list .dev.vars, so there is no repository-level safety net if a developer creates that file locally from the .example template and later runs a broad 'git add'.
